card.name: Inside French and foreign proper names
card.fires_on: Partway through foreign place names, surnames and technical terms, especially French ones split into pieces (Nou-ill-ers, Lik-ou-ala, Le Bour-get). It also fires on odd spots such as digits in IDs and URL symbols.

modes.label: French and foreign names
modes.description: A middle piece of a French, Congolese or German place name or surname.

modes.label: Digits and URL symbols
modes.description: A digit inside a username or date, or an ampersand in a web address.
